contexts.text: A speech of Spirits... undulating like a wave. AC 6923.
Many Spirits acted (by) as it were a reciprocal undulation downwards and upwards.
I felt a pulsation... undulating in a similar manner...
Others inflowed into the pulse, by an undulation not downwards and upwards, but transversely.
The action of these Spirits is into the left knee... with a kind of vibration of an undulation... AC 1686.
He stood at the occiput, and spoke with me thence undulatorily. SE 1682.
The heavenly aura in which their thoughts fly and undulate...
The speech of the Angels was... perceived by me only as a gentle undulation... above and backwards.
When such speak, it takes place with an undulation as of the waves of the sea.
There was first as it were a reciprocal undulation, downwards and upwards...
A commotion (which) undulated tremulously.
Speech with me from Heaven by means of a kind of general undulation...
The general undulation of Heaven was perceived, (which) was the respiration of Heaven.
Thus (Sirens) may undulate from one extreme of fire and ice to the other.
On a tritutory undulation.
The Spirits above me undulated quickly, like the atmosphere. Explained.
They saluted their own people in a volume, by a kind of undulation. Described.
There was a kind of undulation descending from the Spirits above the head...

These Spirits from the side of Gehenna... acted by an undulatory vibration, by which they also spoke; for to speak by means of an undulation had often been done before. The undulation fell towards the left knee, and extended itself towards the sole... As the front of the knee and the foot are bony, they are such that the speech of (such Spirits) falls thither with a vibratory undulation.
These Spirits... undulated gently, by thus speaking among themselves.
Lascivious girls flowed together above my head with a rather sweet undulation. Described.
This undulating volume adhered to my head...
The deceitful... at a middle distance above my head, were perceived as a kind of undulation, as it were a pure watery one.
(He supposed the soul to be) something of ether, as it were undulating generally...
The speech (of the celestial) is like a soft undulatory [motion] which however is audible.
